Read `AGENTS.md`, then `docs/policies/AI.md` and `docs/agents/context.md`; they are the
policy and the operational context, and this file only points at them.

Hard limits: never push to `master`/`int/*` or another person's branch, never author
commit or PR prose verbatim, never add `Signed-off-by:`/`Co-authored-by:`, never edit
`dist/languages/**`, and open issues only in this repository, never upstream.
